findings.title: Laterness becomes a value rule
findings.claim: The later horizon is presented as both more choice-worthy and more enduring, so the ayah turns the preceding near-life preference into a value judgment with temporal depth.
findings.mechanism: The focus form carrying the afterlife meets 87:16's preference for near life and exact comparison parallels such as 28:60 and 20:73. The later-or-other and deferred facets identify the alternative, the good facets qualify its worth, and the persistence facet supplies the duration axis; the three contacts make the comparison operate as a selection measure.
findings.reader_payoff: A reader can hear the sentence as a usable criterion: laterness identifies what is being compared, goodness evaluates it, and endurance tests that evaluation over time.
findings.containment: The ordinary afterlife comparison remains the floor. Temporal pressure here does not turn the noun into the verb of delaying, material wealth is not activated as the meaning of khayr, and 20:127 keeps endurance itself available in a punitive horizon rather than making duration automatically good.

epistemic.reason: The focus carriers and branch facets are supplied exactly, and trusted cross-run evidence anchors the comparison. Legacy walks add the choice-rule formulation, while several target connections supply exact Arabic but not target morphology, so the wider relation remains explicitly qualified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir öğe, ilk olandan sonra gelmesi veya ilk ya da tek olmayıp başka olması bakımından nitelenir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun names the afterlife in its ordinary local construction and carries the later-or-other relation at its surface.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 87:16 places the preference on near worldly life, while 28:60 supplies the same worldly-versus-better-and-enduring contrast.
branch_activations.activation: The later-or-other facet meets the explicit near-life alternative, making the focus horizon the alternative being evaluated rather than an unconnected temporal label.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The afterlife's laterness identifies the deferred counterpart that the ayah sets before the earlier preference.
branch_activations.boundary: The local eschatological noun remains intact; not every occurrence of akhirah is being reduced to a generic later-or-other label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir olay veya öğe daha sonraki zamana bırakılır ya da bir özne zaman veya sıra bakımından geride kalır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus afterlife noun carries the later horizon while its local grammar selects the named final realm.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The near-life preference in 87:16 meets the explicit ordering of what is brought forward and put back in 75:13.
branch_activations.activation: The ordering contact lets laterness register as a deferred horizon against immediate preference, without changing the noun into a postponing action.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The comparison measures what is put beyond the immediate moment as a later alternative with evaluative force.
branch_activations.boundary: No adjustable deadline, commercial deferment, or lexical claim that the focus itself performs delay is made.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Herkesçe arzu edilen ve kötülüğün karşısında duran genel olumlu değeri bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The indefinite good-value predicate carries the general positive quality assigned to the later horizon.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 28:60 and 20:131 place the same good-and-enduring expression against worldly provision or display.
branch_activations.activation: The external comparisons turn khayr from a free-standing compliment into the positive value that qualifies which horizon deserves preference.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The later horizon is desirable in kind, not merely later in sequence.
branch_activations.boundary: The wealth-as-good branch and a universal claim about every desirable object are not asserted.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi veya şeyi iyilik ve değer bakımından üstün, iyi ve seçkin olarak niteler.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 18:46 joins good with enduring righteous works, and 11:86 joins good with a valuable remainder.
branch_activations.activation: These value-and-endurance contacts make qualitative excellence meet the persistence axis in the focus comparison.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Better names a quality of the alternative that remains meaningful when duration is also considered.
branch_activations.boundary: No aesthetic, social-status, or material-wealth specialization is imported.

branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not by itself issue a mechanical command for every human choice or settle every possible preference.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: More enduring is a real dimension of the ayah's valuation, while duration alone does not determine the value.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that every enduring state is beneficial or that the comparative form names an independent preserving agent.

findings.title: A good remainder, not every remainder
findings.claim: The focus's remaining quality can be heard as a useful and good remainder set against the worthless residue left by the pasture cycle.
findings.mechanism: The focus form carrying endurance supplies the remaining portion, while 87:5 provides refuse as an independent residue image and 11:86 supplies a valued remainder. Khayr then qualifies what remains, so the material contact changes 'more enduring' from mere survival into valuable survival.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish two kinds of what is left: the discarded remainder that signals depletion and the enduring remainder that still carries value.
findings.containment: The refuse and usable-remnant images are a bounded contextual analogy, not a physical description that replaces the afterlife reference. Remaining does not automatically mean good, and no exhaustive theory of all residue is claimed.

epistemic.reason: The trusted candidate supplies exact focus branch anchors and the legacy walks supply the 87:5 residue contrast. The target connections contribute exact Arabic relations without target morphology, so the material image is retained as a qualified contextual resonance.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir bütünün bir bölümü gider veya kullanılır; geride kalan bölüm sonuç olarak bulunmaya devam eder.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus endurance form carries the image of a portion remaining after change or use.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 87:5 supplies the discarded chaff image, while 11:86 supplies a remainder explicitly valued as good.
branch_activations.activation: The two residue outcomes meet the focus carrier and distinguish useful persistence from refuse that remains only as waste.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The endurance claim opens onto a remainder whose continued presence retains usable value.
branch_activations.boundary: The afterlife is not reduced to a physical heap or leftover object; the residue image only qualifies how valuable remaining can be heard.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Herkesçe arzu edilen ve kötülüğün karşısında duran genel olumlu değeri bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus good-value predicate carries the positive quality assigned to the remaining horizon.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The worthless residue of 87:5 and the explicitly better remainder of 11:86 make value the independent qualifier of what remains.
branch_activations.activation: Goodness meets the remaining-portion image and turns persistence into a valued remainder rather than a neutral after-effect.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus praises a remainder whose endurance is beneficial, not merely extant.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not claim that every remnant or every worldly possession is good.

findings.title: Endurance as preserved good
findings.claim: The focus's greater endurance can acquire the quality of good being preserved and kept alive, so its duration is heard as beneficent preservation rather than empty extension.
findings.mechanism: The comparative endurance carrier meets the focus good predicate and the non-beneficial continuation boundary supplied by 87:13; 20:73 provides a forgiveness-and-choice scene in the same good-and-enduring comparison, while the preserving branch gives continuation a sparing quality and the gift facet gives that preservation beneficence.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear 'more lasting' as a protected continuation whose value is kept intact, while still recognizing that duration by itself carries no positive verdict.
findings.containment: The local form remains a comparative predicate: it does not literally say 'he preserves' as a separate finite action. The mercy-preservation contact is a bounded contextual color, and the punitive endurance parallel in 20:127 remains live.

epistemic.reason: A trusted focus-anchored finding supplies the preserving branch, and legacy walks independently articulate the beneficence contact. The form restriction and absent target morphology require the preservation reading to remain explicitly qualified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Üstün veya yetkili taraf, zarar verme ya da öldürme gücü varken kişiyi bağışlar ve sağ bırakır.
branch_activations.carrier: The comparative endurance form carries continuation as the focus predicate.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 87:13 supplies a state of continuation without benefit, while 20:73 joins the exact good-and-enduring wording to belief and forgiveness under pressure.
branch_activations.activation: The contrast between mere continuation and forgiveness-preserved life lets the preserving branch qualify what kind of endurance the focus praises.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: More enduring can be heard as being kept alive in a beneficial preservation, not simply lasting longer.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not become a finite sentence saying that an agent preserves someone; the preserving image remains attached to the comparative endurance claim.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişide bulunan cömertlik ve bolca verme niteliğini bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus good predicate carries beneficence as the quality that evaluates endurance.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The coordinated endurance term and the forgiveness scene in 20:73 supply an independent preserving contact against the non-beneficial continuation of 87:13.
branch_activations.activation: Gift-like beneficence meets preservation and gives the continued state a quality of being beneficially kept.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The enduring good is colored as a preserved benefit rather than a cold surplus of time.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not assert a separate gift event or reduce khayr to generosity in every context.

findings.title: A remainder that carries forward
findings.claim: The immediately following sheets give the focus's endurance a retrospective and transmissible form: what remains can carry teaching from an earlier time, while 87:5 keeps discarded residue as a live contrast.
findings.mechanism: The focus endurance and remaining-portion carriers meet the sheets in 87:18-19, which supply survival across time and usable transmission, and the refuse scene in 87:5, which distinguishes a surviving teaching from waste. The lasting-word parallel in 43:28 provides an independent transmissible-remnant contact.
findings.reader_payoff: Permanence becomes perceptible as useful continuity that can carry content forward, rather than only as an abstract extension of time.
findings.containment: The sheets exemplify one form of endurance and do not replace the ordinary afterlife reference or define every use of remaining. The contrast with refuse is retained as a boundary, not as a claim that all enduring things transmit teaching.

epistemic.reason: Trusted cross-run evidence anchors the sheets to the focus endurance branch, while several legacy retrospective records add the archival and refuse contact. The target connection supplies exact Arabic but not full target morphology, so the documentary reading is bounded as an inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey yok olmaz; varlığı veya içinde bulunduğu durum sürer.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 87:18-19 place the comparison in former sheets, and 43:28 supplies a lasting word as a transmissible remnant.
branch_activations.activation: A surviving written teaching gives endurance a concrete historical and communicative operation that returns to the focus predicate.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: What is more enduring can be seen as something that remains available to carry an earlier instruction forward.
branch_activations.boundary: The sheets are an example of continuity, not a replacement for the focus's final-realm meaning or a claim about every enduring object.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir bütünün bir bölümü gider veya kullanılır; geride kalan bölüm sonuç olarak bulunmaya devam eder.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus endurance form carries a portion that remains after an originating event has passed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 87:5 provides a discarded residue contrast, while 87:18-19 provide sheets that survive from an earlier source with usable content.
branch_activations.activation: The two forms of remainder make the focus's remaining portion legible as transmissible and beneficial when it carries content forward, rather than as waste merely left behind.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Endurance leaves a remainder whose usefulness and communicability are part of what makes it valuable.
branch_activations.boundary: The archival image remains an example and analogy; it does not turn the afterlife into paper, residue, or a reconstructed historical object.

findings.title: Goodness as a choice criterion
findings.claim: The focus's good names a choice-worthy quality that confronts the earlier act of preferring near life, so the comparison addresses how a person orders choices.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier uses the good-choice facet of khayr. The prior preference in 87:16 and the supplied apportioning scene in 87:8 provide distinct choice pressures, while 20:73 shows the same good-and-enduring wording in a pressured decision context; their contact turns evaluation into an action-facing criterion.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear 'better' as guidance for what deserves preference, not merely as information about a distant realm.
findings.containment: This is a bounded choice relation, not a universal verdict on every preference or a claim that the focus form mechanically commands a decision. The wider choice scenes provide context for the focus; they do not replace its plain comparative assertion.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and carrier are supplied exactly, while the reader-walk formulation and its same-surah choice triggers are legacy-unbound. The relation is retained because the trigger, contact, changed reading, and boundary are explicit, but it remains qualified rather than trusted source fact.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Olasılıklar arasından daha iyi görüleni arayıp ayırmayı, seçmeyi ve seçilmiş sonucu bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus good predicate carries a comparative result that can be heard as choice-worthy.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 87:16 supplies the prior preference for worldly life, 87:8 supplies an apportioning choice pressure, and 20:73 supplies an explicit choice setting around the same good-and-enduring expression.
branch_activations.activation: The focus good meets actual preference and choice scenes, changing the comparison into an invitation to examine and reorder what is chosen.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The ayah presents the enduring good as the option that should be recognized as preferable against the near-life choice.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not settle every human preference or turn the comparative predicate into an independent imperative.
